description: exp102 - clone of exp101 (single-stream, separate q/k/v CompressionMHL attn, local CompressionMultiHeadLUTMH subclass) with PER-SITE tuned LUT config: q_lut,k_lut n_heads=6 inner_in=48 nap=4 tph=32; v_lut n_heads=6 inner_in=48 nap=6 tph=64; out_proj n_heads=8 inner_in=48 inner_out=48 nap=6 tph=128.
